svg.aria-label: One repo per part: Each part is a separate repo synthwerk-<role>. This repo is the map. Two ways in: Drop the widgets into a website, or build your own app with the SDK. Local models, local-first: In development, models run on your machine. No paid AI provider is needed. Self-hosted. What works today: The blueprint, the design tokens, the vision classifier, the contracts and the local spine stack. The other services are planned or in rewrite
